scenario: E-2 composed case: typePairing + explicit fontFamilyHeading in ONE document, both doors
law: explicit family wins over the tenant's own pairing selection when both are authored in the same document (E-2 fix, brand-theme/index.ts + tenant-theme/index.ts).
